subject: Annual Planning: Orchestration Timeline & Ownership Handover
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Annual Planning: Orchestration Timeline & Ownership Handover

Team —

I'm starting the orchestration pass for annual planning and want to hand over the timeline and ownership matrix for leadership review. Goal is to lock a base timeline and owners by EOD June 10 so we can start downstream workstreams (forecast, hiring needs, Dedicated capacity planning).

Key asks in this note:
- Please review the attached timeline (annual_plan_timeline_v1.xlsx) and ownership matrix (ownership_matrix_v1.csv). I've proposed owners and milestone dates.
- Confirm or propose an alternate owner for each milestone by EOD June 6.
- Flag any schedule conflicts or decision gates that need Exec sign-off.

Proposed milestones (high level):
- Jun 11: Finalized top-line targets and scenario bands
- Jun 18: Finance alignment and cost model sign-off
- Jun 21: QBR readiness checkpoint (leadership review)
- Jul 2: Final FY plan published (internal)

Note on risks: I added a column in the sheet for "SLA spend delta" thresholds — we should agree on tolerance levels before the finance review.

I've attached a QBR checklist (qbr_checklist.docx) and linked a living doc here: https://drive.google.com/document/d/1AqPlannedTimeline. I'll circulate calendar slots for the June 21 checkpoint once owners confirm availability.

Thanks — please keep replies short (confirm/change) so I can collapse updates into the master sheet.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: annual_plan_timeline_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), ownership_matrix_v1.csv (CSV), qbr_checklist.docx (doc)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual Planning: Orchestration Timeline & Ownership Handover

Thanks Priyom — looked through the sheets quickly. Two quick items:
1) For the "Demand & GTM assumptions" milestone I recommend moving ownership from me to Jonas Weber (I copied him in my local notes) — he owns the go-to-market forecasts now and can drive the cross-product assumptions.
2) June 21 is tight for the CS leadership offsite; can we propose a backup window week of Jun 28 for the QBR readiness checkpoint? I'll mark conflicts in the timeline and send a short comment in the Drive doc.

Otherwise the milestone cadence looks good. I'll confirm specific names in the ownership sheet by EOD Jun 6.

—Marissa
VP, Growth Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Annual Planning: Orchestration Timeline & Ownership Handover

Quick note from the leadership perspective:
- Please add a decision gate row for "Spend vs Target" with attached thresholds. We need a clear escalation path if unit economics deviate by more than X% (add the X placeholder and finance will fill in).
- Laura, can your team own finance alignment and ensure the cost model includes Dedicated capacity scenarios?
- We should reserve a 90-minute in-person slot for the Jun checkpoint — not purely async. Priyom, work with People Ops to block 2pm-3:30pm on Jun 21 as tentative; if that's impossible due to conflicts, prioritize the week of Jun 28.

Also — loop in Karthik and Marcus for infra cost sensitivity; they should be in the ownership matrix.

Once you update the sheet, I'll run it by Execs and confirm the tolerance levels.

—Vivek
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual Planning: Orchestration Timeline & Ownership Handover

Thanks all — updated the artifacts and pushed new versions to Drive. Summary of updates:
- annual_plan_timeline_v1.xlsx -> annual_plan_timeline_v1.1 (owners adjusted per Marissa; Jonas added for GTM assumptions)
- ownership_matrix_v1.csv -> ownership_matrix_v1.1 (Karthik and Marcus added for infra sensitivity)
- added a "Decision gate: Spend vs Target" row with a placeholder for tolerance bands. Finance (Laura) please populate before Jun 18.
- I tentatively blocked Jun 21 14:00-15:30 PT for an in-person QBR readiness review; calendar invite will be sent once owners confirm. Backup window is Jun 28 14:00-15:30.

Next steps:
- Owners confirm by EOD Jun 10 so I can lock the schedule and notify workstreams.
- Laura to add the cost-model cells and populate tolerance bands by Jun 18.
- I'll prepare the one-page exec brief for the Jun checkpoint (draft in Drive).

Short replies (confirm/change) appreciated. I'll collapse confirmations into a single revision of the sheets.

—Priyom
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
